environment.description: Actix-web service deployed on an EC2 instance in a VPC with default security groups. The PostgreSQL database user 'webapp' has full DML privileges (SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE) on the webhooks table. The instance has an IMDSv1-enabled metadata endpoint at 169.254.169.254. No egress filtering or URL validation beyond the reachability check in code. The service runs with network access to internal VPC resources including Redis, internal APIs, and the EC2 metadata service.

config.database_role: webapp WITH GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON webhooks
